rows.name: Traction elevator
rows.gaps: Shaft simplified to two back walls plus steel columns on the open side; no landing doors, governor or travelling cable; static plate with no motion.

rows.name: Battery energy storage cabinet
rows.gaps: Count includes every module handle and connector (above the 40-80 Figure range); internal busbars, DC cabling and fire suppression not drawn.

rows.name: Open-circuit cooling tower
rows.gaps: Front casing cut away above the louvers; spray laterals mostly hidden behind their support beam; ladder has no safety cage.

rows.name: EV DC fast charger
rows.gaps: Cable drawn as a short loop (a real one is about 4-5 m) with no cable-management arm; the bay asphalt is a large plain face.

rows.name: Water-cooled centrifugal chiller
rows.gaps: Liquid line, economizer and oil system left out; the machine is long and low, so the square card has empty space above and below; one audit crowding pair (discharge line onto condenser nozzle) excused as a real joint.
